en.headline: Observatory cancels Strong Monsoon Signal at 1.45pm
en.dek: The signal that had been in force since the early hours was lifted on Sunday afternoon as winds moderated; red flags remained at several beaches earlier in the day.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory cancelled the Strong Monsoon Signal at 1.45pm on Sunday. The signal had been in force for much of the day, with strong easterly winds expected to exceed 40 kilometres per hour on average and gusts occasionally reaching gale force.

Earlier in the morning the Observatory had issued a special weather tip warning that a rain band south of Hong Kong was approaching and that heavier showers with squally thunderstorms were likely in places for a few hours. The Leisure and Cultural Services Department also hoisted red flags at Stanley Main Beach, Shek O Beach, Big Wave Bay Beach, Cheung Chau Tung Wan Beach, Trio Beach and Silverstrand Beach because of big waves.

With the signal now cancelled, the Observatory expects the weather to remain cloudy with a few showers, while the tropical depression over the central South China Sea continues to move towards the coast of Vietnam.

zh.headline: 天文台下午1時45分取消強烈季候風信號
zh.dek: 信號於周日下午取消，日間大部分時間生效；稍早康文署因大浪在多個泳灘懸掛紅旗。
body: 香港天文台於周日下午1時45分取消強烈季候風信號。該信號日間大部分時間生效，預料本港吹偏東強風，平均風速每小時超過40公里，陣風間中達烈風程度。
天文台早上曾發出特別天氣提示，指本港以南雷雨帶逐漸靠近，未來兩三小時部分地區雨勢較大及有狂風雷暴。康樂及文化事務署亦因大浪在赤柱正灘、石澳泳灘、大浪灣泳灘、長洲東灣泳灘、三星灣泳灘及銀線灣泳灘懸掛紅旗。
信號取消後，天文台預料天色大致多雲，有幾陣驟雨，而位於南海中部的熱帶低氣壓將繼續移向越南沿岸。
